title: Nathan's Parable of the Poor Man's Lamb
description: The prophet Nathan tells David the parable of the rich man who took the poor man's only lamb, and David realizes that the parable is about himself.

versions.reason: [critical] duplicate: This story covers exactly the same narrative as 'Nathan Rebukes David' (2 Sam 12:1-25), which already includes the parable of the poor man's lamb. It also overlaps significantly with 'David and Bathsheba'.
